origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.name: Aẓar n tẓuri

power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_levitation: Yettwaqeblen: yexḍer taẓeṭṭa yerna yuli ɣef uselmed (Levitation I). Yettwaqeblen  yettwaqeblen s tqeffalt n tmusni.
